title: 3 Ways to Break Free from Lifestyle Inflation

segments.text: You're letting lifestyle inflation sneak up on you.
It starts small but grows bigger over time.
This is why you feel broke after a raise.
Mindset shift: see needs vs. wants clearly.
Remember, wealth isn't just what you earn.
Want to really enjoy your income? Follow for more.

description: Lifestyle inflation can quietly drain your wealth. Learn to identify it and keep your money. Follow to master your finances. 💵
